# Gingerbread
Gingerbreads are a species of sentient confectionary. They have sugar for blood, and can be butchered for cookies.
## Benefits
- Being made of dough, they weigh half as much as species made of flesh. - Gingerbreads take [color=#1e90ff]3x less fire damage[/color] than Humans. - They [color=#1e90ff]cannot take Asphyxiation damage[/color] (though they still breathe and are uncomfortable without oxygen). - They [color=#1e90ff]cannot take Bloodloss damage[/color] (though again, are uncomfortable without sugar). - They [color=#1e90ff]cannot take Cold damage[/color] (though are slowed down by cold).
## Drawbacks
- They take [color=#FFA500]1.5x more Blunt damage.[/color] - They take a lot of [color=#FFA500]Heat damage[/color] from being exposed to water externally.
